articles.summary: CBS News Videos: Busy Queens street will soon have quiet spot for prayer and reflection. The opening of a shrine dedicated to Saint Pio, who is revered by many Italian-American Catholics, is a labor of love and devotion for a local man and his family. CBS News New York's Tony Aiello reports.

articles.title: Yale Fertility Center Named to Newsweek's List of America's Best Fertility Clinics 2026
articles.mainIdea: Yale Fertility Center Named to Newsweek's List of America's Best Fertility Clinics 2026
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Yale Fertility Center Named to Newsweek's List of America's Best Fertility Clinics 2026. Yale Fertility Center has been named to Newsweek's list of America's Best Fertility Clinics 2026, distinguishing it as the sole fertility practice in Connecticut to earn a spot on the prestigious national ranking. The rankings were announced on April 22, 2026.
